### Workflow entry: urlshort-slice@1 step requirements

Requirements allocated: FR-1..FR-6, FR-9; NFR-S1, S3, S4, R5, R6, A1, A2, M3, O1, O2, plus cross-cutting M1, M2. This slice owns the committed OpenAPI export docs/api/openapi.json (deterministic, key-sorted). Read missions/01-greenfield-core/SPEC.md (allocation, shaping rules) and missions/01-greenfield-core/slices/01-create-redirect/slice.yaml (territory, grants) before starting.

Step objective: Write the slice SPEC.md: user stories, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria, business rules, scope, ambiguity log, proof contract. Park a real ambiguity on the human; otherwise record safe defaults.
